name: preview-watermark
title: Preview watermark
description: Marks unlocked work with a light recipient or build overlay for screenshots. Does not verify codes, persist state, or grant or revoke access. Contract: the consumer owns lifecycle timestamps and action callbacks.

meta.whenToUse: Unlocked work should carry who it was prepared for, including into screenshots that leave the review.
meta.notFor: A draft status strip. Use Preview ribbon when the label should sit above the work rather than across it.
pitfalls: The overlay is visual. It does not prevent copies, and it is not authorization.
meta.contract: Marks unlocked work with a light recipient or build overlay for screenshots. Does not verify codes, persist state, or grant or revoke access. Contract: the consumer owns lifecycle timestamps and action callbacks.

props.name: children
props.description: Work shown under the mark; required.

props.name: labels
props.description: Localized mark text when recipient and build are omitted.

props.name: theme
props.description: Explicit theme; omitted follows the system preference.

meta.a11y: Native controls, visible focus, localized labels; the repeating mark is decorative and hidden from assistive technology. No modal dialog is created.

docs: UI only. Read https://knock.codes/docs/preview-watermark.md. Consumers own authorization.
